what: The declared stream-position instrument: the state space 1296 ordered types with the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries, with the real's own kept-adjacent pair sequence divided into four declared equal-count consecutive segments, each segment's profile priced fresh, the four segment profiles recorded beside each other and beside the whole-sequence profile, no bands and no envelopes. The declared truthful question: is the real's concentration a smooth function of stream position, or do particular spans of the stream carry it, answered by which segments' scalars sit above the whole-sequence values and which below, the span effect the cut-geometry instrument attributed to the stream's opening pairs. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, the mark located in each matrix's own alphabet, and the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side)
declared.partition_rule: the real's own ordered kept-adjacent pair sequence divided into four declared equal-count consecutive segments, the boundaries placed by the standing basis arithmetic the rungs already use (the first three boundaries at int(quarter x the anchor basis) positions with the anchor basis the kept pair total + 1, at the quarters 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75, the last boundary the sequence's end); every file's kept pair total is three over a multiple of four, so each file's first three segments are the same size and the remainder lands on the last segment; each segment prices every kept-adjacent pair of its own consecutive interval, no pair dropped, no pair synthesized, and the four segments partition the whole sequence exactly
declared.summary_rule: each profile is priced fresh through the same mark-excluded block and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries the standing instruments declare, each segment's own matrix carrying its own mark's row and column excluded; no profile is compared to any simulated profile anywhere in this artifact
declared.no_band_rule: no rung band is loaded, no envelope is formed, no verdict and no scalar margin is produced anywhere in this artifact: the declared question is answered by direction, and the frozen rung bands stay the frozen instruments' declared records, untouched here
declared.direction_rule: each segment records, for each of the six scalar summaries it shares with the whole profile (the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares at k 1, 10 and 50, and the pair entropy), whether its value sits above, below or equal to the whole sequence's value at the stored 6-decimal rounding, every entry recorded and no selection performed over anything
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and no encoding is re-run anywhere: this instrument prices the real's own side only
declared.state_note: the real's kept-adjacency is real adjacency with 126 unmapped events inside ZL's 218,663, 1,769 inside GC's 186,708, none inside IT's 220,532, exactly as disclosed since the interior instrument; the real's side is identical for both languages of a file, so every cell prices the same segment records; the whole-sequence profile is priced fresh here and verified field for field against the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile in the gate
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags, and no seed of any kind: the segments are the declared consecutive quarters and every profile is priced fresh from the real's own pair sequence, so the standing budgets and the seed-kind registry play no part here
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its declared segment after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.record_rule: per cell the artifact records the kept pair total, the four declared boundaries, the whole sequence's profile priced fresh with its boundary-carried pairs, and the four segment records in order, each carrying its segment index, its first and end positions, its kept-adjacent pairs, its own boundary-carried pairs, its fresh profile (the block total, both vector summaries as counts and shares, the empty type count, the self-pair share, the top-k shares and the pair entropy) and its direction record against the whole profile's six scalar summaries, every entry recorded
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is direction per scalar summary per segment, and the record answers it entry by entry
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.gate_rule: before any segment is recorded, the gate verified fresh per cell: the whole profile against the frozen real-at-basis ladder's anchor profile, the four boundaries from the declared rule, the four segment sizes, each segment's block-total identity, the two partition identities, the four segments' kept pairs' sum and the whole's own identity, 17 fields per cell, 102 fields all told; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
